budget_audit.scope: Observed saved executions plus pinned producer source semantics. These observations do not prove adversarial boundary behavior or unexposed provider timing.
budget_audit.response_budget_scope: Actor tools/call responses including failures. Tools/list and control metadata are measured separately.
budget_audit.host_count_scope: Observed worker sequence includes close. The helper guards non-close command sequence against max_calls and accepts the final close separately. Both observed totals are retained.
budget_audit.timing_semantics: No nested durations are added. Actual per-tool handling windows are checked independently of the larger full-cell and consumer windows.

original_preparation_cost.scope: Local work-order through freeze; earlier reading, coordinator and review resource costs unmeasured.

batch_timing.batch_timing_scope: run_models entry through last per-cell RUN_RESULT publication; includes batch setup and cell accounting, excludes final timing-summary publication and caller overhead; not model reasoning time

unmeasured: provider request count and retry count
overlap_rules: cached input is a subset of input; reasoning output is a subset of output
only terminal cumulative turn usage is totaled
stdio layers/body/schema bytes are independent scopes; do not sum them as model input
nested trace spans and startup/finish timings already belong to full cell
outer formal wall and six-cell sums overlap
